title: Crazy Moto
desc: Crazy Moto is a fast-paced motorcycle stunt racing game where physics and balance decide everything. Twist the throttle, fly off ramps and blast through 22 hand-crafted levels packed with loops, explosive barrels, spikes, collapsing platforms and deadly drops. Beat the clock to earn up to 3 stars on every level and chain insane mid-air tricks &mdash; Front Flip, Back Flip, Double Flip and Wheelie &mdash; to rack up a higher score and a faster best time. Spend your stars to unlock and ride powerful new bikes, including the Desert Racer, the Martian and the Firehead, each with its own look and feel.
howto: Desktop Arrow Up W accelerate Arrow Down S brake amp reverse Arrow Left-Right A-D lean and balance the rider in the air for flips Mobile On-screen gas and brake pedals tilt control with the brake gas buttons to balance and perform flip
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
